title: security-eng-sync-notes-2026-03-17
content:
Security Engineering Sync — 2026-03-17
Attendees: Ava Patel (owner), Marcus Lee, Sofia Ramirez, Benji Osei, Jin Park, Dana Holt (guest: infra)
Meeting length: 45m

Agenda:
- Vulnerability triage (open and new findings)
- Secrets scanning updates and remediation cadence
- Threat modeling next steps for Private deployment control plane
- Action items / blockers

1) Vulnerability triage
- SEC-4123: OpenSSL CVE-like chain (third-party dependency). Severity: High (possible RCE with specially crafted TLS handshake). Affected: serving-runtime images built from base v2026-01.
  - Notes: Snyk flagged during scheduled SCA run on 2026-03-16. Reproducer unclear in prod; PoC only on crafted fuzzer.
  - Owner: Marcus Lee. Status: in_progress.
  - Mitigation plan: Pin OpenSSL to patched 1.1.1u / move to vendored BoringSSL in next minor release. Expected rollback window: include emergency patch in release pipeline.
  - Next step: Marcus to open a PR with updated base image and run internal fuzzer matrix. Due: 2026-03-19. Linked: GitHub:repo/inference-runtime/pull/318

- SEC-4124: JWT library (runtime token parsing) — Medium. Potential signature confusion when alg==none in legacy token issuers.
  - Notes: Detected by code review where legacy token handling used non-strict verifier. Not observed in customer traffic.
  - Owner: Sofia Ramirez. Status: triaged / backport_needed.
  - Mitigation plan: Harden verifier to reject alg==none, add unit + integration tests. Backport to 2025.12 LTS branch.
  - Next step: Sofia to prepare test cases and PR. Backport PR required by 2026-03-24.

- New finding: Container image with dev tooling accidentally included (curl, build-essential). Risk: medium (larger attack surface).
  - Owner: Benji Osei. Status: open.
  - Plan: Build minimal runtime image variant (distroless) and add image-slimming CI check. ETA: 2026-03-31.

2) Secrets scanning + remediation cadence
- Summary: Weekly scan results from 2026-03-16 found 5 historical secrets in users/ notes repo (mostly rotated keys). Two findings require follow-up: personal AWS key in dev-scripts.sh (rotated but not marked), GitHub token in archived demo repo (unrestricted scopes).
  - Owners: Jin Park + Dana Holt. Status: in_progress.
  - Steps taken: Keys rotated on detection for AWS key; GitHub token revoked. Both incidents logged to incident-tracker SEC-INC-2026-17.
  - Preventive actions:
    - Enforce repo-based pre-submit scanning (pre-commit + CI) for all repos under org.
    - Add automatic tagging of rotated secrets in the secrets dashboard so scanning alerts are suppressed once rotation is verified.
    - Short-term: run one-off audit of archived repos (scope: users/ and shared_drives demos) by 2026-03-20.
  - Action items: Jin to produce automation spec for tagging rotated secrets (due 2026-03-22). Dana to run archived repo audit (due 2026-03-20).

3) Threat modeling — Private deployment control plane
- Context: Private deployments (VPC/on-prem) add a new control plane surface: customer-managed networking + optional on-prem agents. Need to update threat model and checklist for rollout.
- Key assets: control plane API tokens, provisioning keys, kube credentials, customer config blobs (may contain IP ranges), customer logs (PII potential).
- Attack surface notes:
  - Supply chain: on-prem package build and distribution (signed artifacts required).
  - Lateral movement: if agent runs in customer infra, consider privileged container escapes and credential exfil.
  - Network segmentation: ensure default deny for control plane connections; require mTLS and mutual client certs.
- Action items:
  - Complete a data-flow diagram for control plane — Owner: Ava. Due: 2026-03-24.
  - Create an onboarding hardening checklist for customers deploying Private (include KMS integration, cert rotation frequency, minimum RBAC) — Owner: Marcus. Due: 2026-04-01.
  - Threat mitigations to prototype: artifact signing + verification in installer; runtime sidecar to handle credential refresh with least-privilege scopes — Owner: Benji. Prototype due: 2026-04-07.

4) Ongoing operational items
- Canary telemetry: observability team reported an increase in auth failures during canary runs last week. Investigating whether client cert rotation caused drift. Dana to triage with SRE.
- Rollout gating: Add an explicit security gate in the Dedicated/Docker image rollout pipeline to block releases with critical SCA findings. DevOps cohort to design by 2026-03-28.

5) Action items recap
- Marcus Lee: PR for OpenSSL base image update + fuzz test (due 2026-03-19).
- Sofia Ramirez: JWT verifier hardening + backport PR (due 2026-03-24).
- Benji Osei: minimal runtime image + CI image-slimming check (due 2026-03-31).
- Jin Park: automation spec for tagging rotated secrets in dashboard (due 2026-03-22).
- Dana Holt: archived repo secrets audit + canary auth triage coordination with SRE (due 2026-03-20 / 2026-03-19).
- Ava Patel: control plane data-flow diagram (due 2026-03-24).

Blockers / Decisions Needed:
- Decide whether to adopt BoringSSL vs pinning patched OpenSSL. Security prefers BoringSSL for reduced attack surface; infra team has dependency concerns. Decision needed by 2026-03-19.
- Confirm rollout gating behavior (fail-block vs warning) for critical SCA findings. Meeting with DevOps scheduled 2026-03-18.

Notes / Misc:
- Follow-up: schedule a dedicated 60m threat-model session for Private control plane on 2026-03-23 (invite to include product, infra, and legal).
- Add SEC-4123 to exec incident briefing if PoC reproduces on infra (Ava to notify if escalation needed).

Attachments / Links: JIRA tickets and PRs included above. Snyk full report available on request.

Next sync: 2026-03-24 (regular weekly cadence).
\-- end of notes --
